description: Save and resume capability for partial onboarding progress across sessions

requirements.title: Progress Storage Backend
requirements.description: Database-backed persistence layer that saves onboarding progress including completed steps, partial form data, selected resources, and timestamps, keyed by user or session identity

validation.notes: TestProgressUpdate, TestProgressDefaultUser verify progress persistence and retrieval

requirements.title: Progress Resume Flow
requirements.description: UI flow that detects existing progress on session start, offers to resume from the last completed step, and restores all form state and selections accurately

validation.notes: Dedicated resume tests verify prompt display, resource restoration, and no-progress handling

title: Progress Persistence System
